edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement and the boundary test fails the build

  Scenario: AC4 Business rules BR1 to BR9 hold
    Given the deviation service runs against its fake contracts
    When a deviation is raised, its outcome is recorded and its events are published
    Then every rule of section 8 from BR1 to BR9 holds for the rows written, the decision records kept and the events published

  Scenario: AC5 Error answers of the provided operations
    Given a request reaches a provided operation without a valid credential, with a role lacking the Case record right, or with an unknown deviation id
    When the operation answers
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 for those three requests respectively and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC6 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given a write has been accepted with an Idempotency-Key
    When the same write is replayed with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then nothing is written or published a second time and the caller receives the one record

  Scenario: AC7 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event
    Given a consumed event has been processed once
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then its effect is applied once and no second row or event is written

  Scenario: AC8 Activity retry and timeout
    Given an activity of this service is retried or times out
    When the retry or the timeout occurs
    Then the activity leaves no partial row and no second event behind

  Scenario: AC9 Disallowed status change refused
    Given a deviation is in a state from which section 8 allows no transition for the requested change
    When the status change is requested
    Then the change is refused, nothing is written and no event is published
